summary: Return the fixed J=8 or J=12 complex residue and pole tables with conjugate completion.

identity.relation: integer pole count J to residues and complex pole positions
identity.direction: integer pole count J to residues and complex pole positions
identity.definition: Z(zeta) is approximated by sum_j bzj[j]/(zeta-czj[j]); the stored first half is completed by conjugation and negative conjugation, respectively.
identity.model: rational approximation of the Maxwellian plasma dispersion function
identity.coordinates: dimensionless complex zeta plane; one pole axis
identity.boundary: only the frozen J=8 and J=12 tables exist; no interpolation or extrapolation
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: j_order
inputs.description: 极点阶数 J，选定一组固定留数与位置，并决定返回数组长度与每组分极点块大小
inputs.constraints: 只能取 8 或 12，分别对应源码的 8 极点表与 12 极点表，其他阶数在源码中无表因而必须失败关闭。

outputs.name: bzj
outputs.description: 各极点的留数，矩阵按极点轴加权共振项
outputs.constraints: 有限复数，后半段必须等于前半段的复共轭。

outputs.name: czj
outputs.description: 各极点位置，给出复共振偏移并进入共振宗量分母
outputs.constraints: 有限复数，后半段必须等于前半段复共轭的相反数。

outputs.name: j_order
outputs.description: 本次实际使用的极点阶数，回显输入以便调用者核对矩阵分块

outputs.name: half_order
outputs.description: 源码写定的前半段极点个数 `J/2`，用于核对共轭补齐边界

outputs.name: sum_bzj
outputs.description: 留数总和，用于核对零阶矩条件

outputs.name: sum_bzcj
outputs.description: 留数与极点位置乘积的总和，用于核对一阶矩条件

outputs.name: sum_bzcj2
outputs.description: 留数与极点位置平方乘积的总和，用于核对二阶矩条件

preconditions: only the frozen J=8 and J=12 tables exist; no interpolation or extrapolation
supported: Return the fixed J=8 or J=12 complex residue and pole tables with conjugate completion.
excluded: No mode identity or arbitrary-parameter accuracy is inferred beyond the declared numerical method.
